camera_lock_addon: . Locked-off camera on a tripod. No camera pan, tilt, roll, dolly, zoom, or viewpoint change. Single continuous shot with no cuts or transitions. The object stays fully visible at all times, centered and same size throughout. Object appearance, shape, color, and material stay consistent throughout; the moving part's identity does not change. No new objects, humans, hands, animals, or props appear in the scene. Stable lighting and background.
neg_prompt: camera pan, camera tilt, camera dolly, camera zoom, camera shake, camera roll, viewpoint change, perspective shift, scene transition, cut, montage, follow shot, tracking shot, dolly shot, close-up, background drift, object scale change, object identity drift, moving part shape change, moving part color change, person appears, hand appears, new object appears, animal appears, prop appears, overexposed, underexposed, lighting change, low resolution, blur, artifacts, watermark, subtitle, deformed, distorted
